job.value: catch up on alerts and open the one that needs attention

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Updates' with 'All / For action / Activity / Promos / Support' tabs and a list of alerts makes the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: For an inbox the rows are the action and the highlighted unread '5 new Good Deals…' row leads.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Tabs and 'View order details >' say what they show.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Lines like 'kazukitcg made an offer on your listing' and 'Your parcel is on its way' use familiar words.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decisions are asked beyond which update to open.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each row is a title plus one line, with detail behind the tap.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: A mixed buyer/seller feed is what an updates inbox is for.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Each row reads at a glance from its bold title.
